description: This file defines the `MessageReplyReceiver` class, a BroadcastReceiver that handles incoming reply intents for messaging conversations, logs the reply, and updates notifications accordingly.

classes.name: MessageReplyReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that processes reply messages in messaging conversations, logs received replies, and updates the notification UI.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents; extracts reply message and conversation ID, logs the reply, and updates notification.

methods.name: getMessageText
methods.description: Extracts remote reply text from the intent using RemoteInput.
